procedure: The containing public Git commit is the complete build source. Starting at public_base_revision, apply its product diff from that baseline; no private checkout is required. The source_revision records the origin of the saved-check and notification implementation, not a public installation prerequisite. Preserve the public bounded-predicate and cache interfaces. Integrate the existing custody implementation through the explicit public schema-v5 to schema-v12 migration, rather than importing another schema line or its history. Existing public tags are unchanged.
limitations: Source-module hashes identify original inputs; integration formatting and compatibility changes are recorded by the public Git diff.
This source distribution does not qualify a full recurring monitoring or notification deployment.
